notes: This corpus appears to be a comprehensive archive of federal and state litigation coverage focused on the Northern District of California from approximately 2015-2025. The articles heavily emphasize privacy litigation, tech industry disputes, antitrust enforcement, and social media regulation. Several major cases (Roundup, Epic v. Apple, Uber misclassification) recur frequently enough to warrant dedicated tags. The vocabulary prioritizes emerging legal issues like data minimization, age-appropriate design, and algorithmic harms. Named individuals appear infrequently as central figures; instead, the coverage focuses on institutional actors (companies, agencies, courts). Tags for state-by-state privacy laws were consolidated into 'State Privacy Laws' to avoid excessive granularity.
